name: design-components-folder
title: Design Components Folder
author: AlgorizeTech
description: An animated folder that opens to fan out component preview cards. Use it on portfolio and feature pages to reveal a collection on interaction.
docs: Named export: DesignComponentsFolder. Framer Motion drives the open and card-fan animation; `color` tints the folder. Uses next/image, so it needs edits outside Next.js. For the empty folder shape, use `design-folder-box`.
